verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, King Pasenadi said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “idha mayhaṁ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṁ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
verses.english: “Just now, sir, as I was in private retreat this thought came to mind.

verses.pali: ‘kesaṁ nu kho rakkhito attā, kesaṁ arakkhito attā’ti?
verses.english: ‘Who are those who protect themselves? And who are those who don’t protect themselves?’

verses.pali: ‘ye kho keci kāyena duccaritaṁ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṁ caranti, manasā duccaritaṁ caranti;
verses.english: ‘Those who do bad things by way of body, speech, and mind

verses.pali: Kiñcāpi te hatthikāyo vā rakkheyya, assakāyo vā rakkheyya, rathakāyo vā rakkheyya, pattikāyo vā rakkheyya;
verses.english: Even if they’re protected by a company of elephants, cavalry, chariots, or infantry,

verses.pali: Bāhirā hesā rakkhā, nesā rakkhā ajjhattikā;
verses.english: Because such protection is exterior, not interior.
That’s why they don’t protect themselves.

verses.pali: Ye ca kho keci kāyena sucaritaṁ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṁ caranti, manasā sucaritaṁ caranti;
verses.english: Those who do good things by way of body, speech, and mind

verses.pali: Kiñcāpi te neva hatthikāyo rakkheyya, na assakāyo rakkheyya, na rathakāyo rakkheyya, na pattikāyo rakkheyya;
verses.english: Even if they’re not protected by a company of elephants, cavalry, chariots, or infantry,

verses.pali: Ajjhattikā hesā rakkhā, nesā rakkhā bāhirā;
verses.english: Because such protection is interior, not exterior.
That’s why they do protect themselves.’”
“That’s so true, great king! That’s so true!” said the Buddha. And he repeated the king’s statement, adding:

verses.pali: Ye hi keci, mahārāja, kāyena duccaritaṁ caranti …pe…
Bāhirā hesā, mahārāja, rakkhā, nesā rakkhā ajjhattikā;
Ye hi keci, mahārāja, kāyena sucaritaṁ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṁ caranti, manasā sucaritaṁ caranti;
Kiñcāpi te neva hatthikāyo rakkheyya, na assakāyo rakkheyya, na rathakāyo rakkheyya, na pattikāyo rakkheyya;
Ajjhattikā hesā, mahārāja, rakkhā, nesā rakkhā bāhirā;
